set.body: Every commit since 2026-07-23 prints three pre-commit hook warnings: 'doc metadata drift; run: worklog ia-normalize', 'inventory stale/invalid; run: worklog ia-inventory', and 'rendered pages/manifest stale; run: worklog ia-render'. Currently non-blocking (WARNING, not a hard gate), but the hook itself says this becomes a hard gate soon. Run the three suggested worklog commands (ia-normalize, ia-inventory, ia-render) to bring docs/.index/ back in sync with the committed docs, then commit the regenerated index files, before it starts failing commits outright.

set.body: bin/ia_render.py's banner() function (lines 65-73): the 'truth_state == current and is_frozen(rec)' branch always renders '> **Current** — the latest %s report...' with %s defaulting to rec.get('kind', 'status') when kind is absent. Plan docs (doc_type=plan) are frozen and current but have no 'kind' field, so they fall through to the same wording and get published with a wiki banner reading 'the latest status report' — wrong for a plan. Confirmed live on all 3 published plan pages (Plan-wiki-ticket-ui, Plan-wiki-ticket-ui-ia, Plan-tauri-desktop-shell). Fix: branch on doc_type (or require an explicit kind per doc_type) before defaulting to 'status'.
set.title: banner() mislabels frozen plan docs as 'status report' — doc_type not checked in ia_render.py's current+frozen branch

set.body: Publishing to the wiki (updating .work/published.json) then running ia-normalize causes it to write 'ledger <key>' updates into per-doc sidecars, which changes docs/.index/_inventory.json again — so a single ia-normalize/ia-inventory/ia-render pass right after a wiki-publish still leaves the pre-commit hook's drift warnings firing; a second identical pass is needed to actually settle. This is the same class of recurring warning already fixed once in #14, but with a different trigger (wiki-publish, not just doc changes). Consider either running the ia pass twice inside wiki-publish itself, or documenting that wiki-publish must be followed by a second ia-normalize/ia-inventory/ia-render pass before committing.
set.title: ia-normalize back-writes ledger refs into doc sidecars after wiki-publish, re-staling the inventory it just wrote

set.resolution: Fixed in bin/ia_render.py's banner(): plan doc_type now gets its own wording instead of falling through to the status-report default.

Fixed by documenting the required re-run in CLAUDE.md's work-tracking policy: run worklog ia-index after any op that touches .work/todo.jsonl or .work/published.json, and re-run once more if git status still shows index files changing.
